name: Lead research
job: Know who someone is before you reply
intro: Lead research looks up new people and companies the first time they matter: their role, what the company does, its size and news, and how well it fits you. Every fact has its link.
does: Decides who is worth looking up, and skips receipts, colleagues and friends.
Keeps a fact only when a page confirms it. Not found is an answer too.
Scores each company against one sentence about who fits your team.
setup: Say who fits your team in one sentence, with a few example companies.
Choose which kinds of people to look up, and how many a day.
Check who it would look up, then let it start.
